questiontext.text:
List the first \(5\) terms of the following sequence.

\( \qquad \qquad \displaystyle \text{S}_n= \begin{Bmatrix} {@w[n]@} \end{Bmatrix}_{{@q[1]@}}^{\infty }\)

\( \quad\quad \quad \quad \quad = \) [[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

Note: The terms should be written as a list inside [ ]. brackets as shown above.

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

Starting at \({@q[1]@}\) , plug in the first five values of \(n\) into the formula for the sequence terms.

\( \qquad \qquad \displaystyle \text{S}_n= \begin{Bmatrix} {@w[n]@} \end{Bmatrix}_{{@q[1]@}}^{\infty }\)

\( \displaystyle n={@q[1]@}: \, S_{@q[1]@}=\frac{({@aa@})^{({@q[1]@}+1)}}{({@bb@}^{{@q[1]@}}+({@cc@}) \cdot {@q[1]@})}={@w[q[1]]@}\)

\(\displaystyle n= {@q[2]@}: \, S_{@q[2]@}=\frac{({@aa@})^{({@q[2]@}+1)}}{({@bb@}^{{@q[2]@}}+({@cc@}) \cdot {@q[2]@})}={@w[q[2]]@}\)

\(\displaystyle n= {@q[3]@}: \, S_{@q[3]@}=\frac{({@aa@})^{({@q[3]@}+1)}}{({@bb@}^{{@q[3]@}}+({@cc@}) \cdot {@q[3]@})}={@w[q[3]]@}\)

\(\displaystyle n={@q[4]@}: \, S_{@q[4]@}=\frac{({@aa@})^{({@q[4]@}+1)}}{({@bb@}^{{@q[4]@}}+({@cc@}) \cdot {@q[4]@})}={@w[q[4]]@}\)

\(\displaystyle n= {@q[5]@}: \, S_{@q[5]@}=\frac{({@aa@})^{({@q[5]@}+1)}}{({@bb@}^{{@q[5]@}}+({@cc@}) \cdot {@q[5]@})}={@w[q[5]]@}\)

So, the first five terms of the sequence are,

\(\qquad \qquad \begin{Bmatrix} {@ta1@}, {@ta2@}, {@ta3@}, {@ta4@}, {@ta5@} \end{Bmatrix}\)
